parts.text: Feature availability: whether a column is known at the prediction moment. A column known only later is leakage: it makes the model look better on past data than it can be in use. Recommended: The case's statement for each column, with every doubtful or undocumented column excluded: a doubt about the timing is a leakage risk. From the case: 5 columns available, 0 not available, 1 doubtful. Doubtful: acceleration.

explain.text: **Feature availability**: Whether a variable is known at the prediction time. It is a decision about the use case, not a property the data can prove.
The case describes one row as: A vehicle model for a model year. For each variable you decide whether it is known at the prediction moment.
Each candidate variable gets one status. Uncertain variables are either excluded or included and listed as a limit. A time column is not a candidate variable; it orders the rows.
Variables marked not available, or uncertain and excluded, never enter a model.
A change that alters the set of usable variables refits the linear model and asks for the model choice again.
